Units

TAG fields four playable units in one persistent Arma Reforger campaign. Each has its own training path, roster and role within the larger event.

75th Rangers160th SOARRRCDEVGRU

75th Rangers

The Rangers are TAG’s main ground force for Sunday missions. Ground recruits enter Ranger probation after Basic Training T2. Line squads provide the core of the event roster, the weapons squad fills specialist ground billets, and platoon HQ keeps the squads and supporting elements coordinated.

ElementStanding templateTypical roles
11–13 · Line squads9 seats eachSquad leader, two fireteam leads, grenadiers, rifleman, automatic riflemen and Rifleman / ARFR.
14 · Weapons squad9 seatsSquad leader, machine-gun and HAT teams, team leaders and gunners.
15 · Reserves9 seatsReserve roster for eligible members covering campaign and training slots.
16 · Platoon HQ9 seatsPlatoon commander and sergeant, CCT, JTAC, platoon medic, UAV operator, RTO and ammo bearers.

These are standing template numbers. Individual event rosters can open different seats. Rifleman / ARFR uses the Medic qualification.

160th SOAR

The aviation element provides player-flown support, including transport and coordination with ground elements. Its standing template has 8 pilot and 8 crew seats, including a lead pilot. Pilot recruits complete TAG Basic Training T1 and T2 before Basic Pilot Training.

Rotary, fixed-wing and CAS qualifications apply to the seats the scenario offers. Crew assignments and aircraft availability are confirmed on the relevant event roster.

Regimental Reconnaissance Company

RRC turns campaign questions into in-game reconnaissance tasks. Its members gather observations, screenshots and findings for campaign staff, who use those results when preparing the next Sunday operation.

The path is Ranger probation, RRC selection and the RRC Operator qualification. Team size and the roles needed are set on the individual task roster.

DEVGRU

DEVGRU takes on selected shaping tasks within the campaign. A tasked team arranges a session that works for its members, then reports what happened so the next briefing can reflect it.

The Alpha, Bravo and Charlie roster shown in TAG has six positions per team. Event assignments depend on the scenario. The entry path starts with Ranger probation, followed by DEVGRU selection and Green Team.
